question: Sangeet Natak Akademi awardee, Prabhat Sarma from Assam was an eminent player of which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flute**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prabhat Sarma** from Assam was an eminent player of the **Flute**.
 
• He was awarded the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi** award for his contributions to Indian music.
 
• The Flute is a widely recognized instrument in Indian classical music, and Prabhat Sarma's contributions have been significant in popularizing it.
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi award is a national recognition given to outstanding practitioners in the fields of music, dance, and drama.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Sangeet Natak Akademi** is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• It was established by the Indian government in 1952 and is based in New Delhi.
 
• The Akademi is responsible for the promotion and preservation of traditional Indian art forms.
 
• Awards are given annually to artists who have made significant contributions to their respective fields.
 
• Recipients of the Sangeet Natak Akademi award are recognized as leading exponents of their art forms.
